document.title: Lymphoangiocrine signals promote cardiac growth and repair

selector.exact: To conditionally delete Prox1 from LECs, we crossed Cad5(PAC)-CreERT2 mice with Prox1 floxed mice and injected pregnant females with tamoxifen at E13.5 and E14.5.

translation: 为了有条件地从淋巴内皮细胞（LEC）中删除 Prox1，我们将 Cad5(PAC)-CreERT2 小鼠与 Prox1 条件性敲除小鼠杂交，并在妊娠第 13.5 天（E13.5）和第 14.5 天（E14.5）给怀孕雌鼠注射他莫昔芬（TAM）。
